top_reviews.title: Perfect fit and very comfortable!
top_reviews.text: Bought for my son and the fit was perfect! Well made shoes and comfortable for my child.

top_reviews.title: High quality and sharp
top_reviews.text: These shoes look awesome. They are great quality and it’s so cool to have my kiddo match the brand of my shoe. These have been perfect for my super athletic kiddo!

top_reviews.title: cute and comfortable
top_reviews.text:
These are really nice sneakers, made of good quality material and perfect for kids daily use.
I would order half a size smaller as the fit was a little flexible. as expected, good quality for the price. I recommend.

top_reviews.title: Finally, wide shoes!
top_reviews.text: It's such a problem for me to find shoes for my son, he has extra wide feet, there are plenty of options when the kids are small, but when they wear Big Kids shoes- not so many. These fit wide, my son loves them, comfortable, but beware - the color is not as pictured, it's neon red/orange, way brighter then on the pictures. We still kept them , buying them in blue too.
